system.name: System monitor
system.description: CPU, GPU and RAM load for lighting widgets and automations.

bambu.name: Bambu Lab printer
bambu.description: Show print progress on your keyboard over the local network.
bambu.flashOnFinish: Flash when a print finishes or fails

claude.name: Claude Code
claude.description: Light your keyboard when Claude Code is working, waiting for you or done.
claude.waiting: Claude Code is waiting for you
claude.hudOnWaiting: Show the HUD when Claude needs you
claude.flashOnWaiting: Flash the keyboard when Claude needs you

notifications.name: App notifications
notifications.description: Flash a colour when Discord, WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Teams or Outlook show new unread messages.
notifications.bestEffort: Detected from window titles — works while the app's window exists (also minimised or in the background).

mic.name: Microphone mute
mic.description: Mute indicator for lighting widgets and a global hotkey to toggle it.
mic.hotkeyConflict: Ctrl+Shift+M is also Discord's own mute shortcut; pick another combo if you use Discord.

games.name: Games
games.description: Health, ammo, bomb and round state from the official CS2, Dota 2 and League of Legends APIs.
games.notFound: Game not found in your Steam libraries
games.antiCheat: Uses only official game integrations; KeyHalo never reads game memory.

homeAssistant.name: Home Assistant / MQTT
homeAssistant.description: Your keyboard as a light in Home Assistant, plus WPM and battery sensors.

api.name: Local API
api.description: REST and WebSocket API on 127.0.0.1 for scripts, Stream Deck and hooks.

pomodoro.name: Pomodoro
pomodoro.description: Focus and break timer shown on your keyboard.

ui.description: Feed live data from your PC, printer, games and smart home into lighting, the HUD and automations.

system.intervalHint: Only polls while a widget, chart or rule needs the data.
system.note: CPU temperature and GPU data come from the system and may be missing on some hardware.

bambu.off: Enable the integration and enter the printer details to see print progress here.
bambu.step1: On the printer: Settings → Network — note the IP address and the LAN access code (LAN-only / developer mode must allow the local MQTT server).
bambu.step2: Settings → Device (or the sticker / Bambu Handy app) — note the serial number.
bambu.step3: Enter the details here, enable the integration and press Test. KeyHalo only reads status — it never sends print commands.

claude.hooksHint: Add these hooks to ~/.claude/settings.json (or a project's .claude/settings.json). They call the keyhalo CLI installed with the desktop app.
claude.cliHint: Any script can set the state through the local API. Add the token header if you set one.

notifications.detected: Badges are read from window titles every few seconds. Counts update live while this page is open.

mic.hotkeyHint: Global shortcut that toggles the default microphone.
mic.keymapHint: Keymap packs can also bind a key to “Mute microphone” (Media action).

games.gsi: Official Game State Integration — writes a small config file into the game folder.
games.lol: Live Client Data API — nothing to install.
games.none: No game running. Start a match and the data appears here within a second.

ha.step1: In Home Assistant, install the Mosquitto broker add-on and the MQTT integration, and create a user for KeyHalo.
ha.step2: Enter the broker host, port, user and password here, pick a computer name and enable the integration.
ha.step3: With discovery on, a “KeyHalo” device appears with the keyboard as a light (effects = your profiles) plus WPM and battery sensors.

api.noToken: No token — any program on this computer can call the API.
api.custom: any other name fires automation rules with an API trigger
api.wsHint: Pushes the status JSON whenever it changes.

ep.status: Status JSON: profile, devices, WPM, Claude, printer…
ep.action: Run an action: profile, flash, notify, dpi, pomodoro…

pomodoro.hint: Shown on the keyboard by the timer widget. Also controllable from the API and Stream Deck.
